title: English Practice Quiz 0772
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 01: The safest way to prevent cross-contamination is to?
options: keep raw and ready-to-eat foods separate
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: keep raw and ready-to-eat foods separate.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 02: Food handlers should wash their hands?
options: before handling food and after contamination risks
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: before handling food and after contamination risks.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 03: A food storage temperature should be?
options: checked against the applicable food safety requirement
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: checked against the applicable food safety requirement.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 04: Perishable food left at an unsafe temperature should be?
options: handled according to food safety procedures
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: handled according to food safety procedures.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 05: A clean food preparation surface should be?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: sanitised using an approved method.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 06: Food allergies should be managed by?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: checking ingredients and preventing cross-contact.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 07: A use-by date indicates?
options: the date after which the food may be unsafe
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: the date after which the food may be unsafe.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 08: Food waste should be stored?
options: in suitable covered containers and removed regularly
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: in suitable covered containers and removed regularly.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 09: A pest sighting in a food area should be?
options: reported and addressed through pest control procedures
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: reported and addressed through pest control procedures.

questions.question: Food Safety and Hygiene 10: Protective clothing in food preparation helps?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: reduce contamination risks.
